    assert page.get_by_text('bbcgoodfood.com').is_visible()
    assert page.locator('#savedCard').get_attribute('href') == new_url
    page.screenshot(path='prototypes/edit-later-address.png', full_page=True)
    browser.close()
print('Edit-address flow checked: destination and domain update; custom title/description preserved.')
